name: Cypress.io
description_en:
Cypress provides a browser-based testing application and a separate Cloud service for recorded results and team workflows. The homepage covers end-to-end, component and API testing, plus AI-assisted creation. A selected suite verifies its assertions under its environment; it does not prove every application requirement is correct.

This profile examines reliable query chains, test state, cross-origin flows and interpreting CI history. Local testing concepts and hosted-result limits are kept distinct. No dependency, browser runner, application, Cloud account, recorded run or prompt execution was operated.
description_zh:
Cypress 提供基于浏览器的测试应用，以及保存结果和团队流程的独立 Cloud 服务。首页覆盖端到端、组件、API 测试及 AI 辅助创建。特定套件只能验证对应环境下的断言，不能证明全部应用需求正确。

本文评估可靠查询链、测试状态、跨源流程及 CI 历史解读，区分本地测试概念与托管结果限额。本次未操作依赖、浏览器运行器、应用、Cloud 账户、录制运行或提示执行。

sections.title_en: The local test and its hosted record have different roles
sections.title_zh: 本地测试与托管记录职责不同
sections.en: The App executes browser tests, while Cloud organizes recorded outcomes and team analysis. A CI run must be configured to record before hosted history exists. Identify the actual app build, browser and configuration that a result represents. AI-authored tests also need explicit expected outcomes and meaningful failure checks; generating runnable code is not proof that important behavior is asserted. No local or hosted execution occurred here.
sections.zh: App 执行浏览器测试，Cloud 组织录制结果及团队分析；CI 需配置录制后才有托管历史。应明确结果对应的应用构建、浏览器及配置。AI 编写测试也需明确预期结果和有意义失败检查；能运行的代码不证明断言覆盖关键行为。本次未执行本地或托管测试。

sections.title_en: A query retry is not another click
sections.title_zh: 查询重试不是再次点击
sections.en: The retry guide distinguishes linked queries/assertions from non-query commands that execute once. It also describes a mid-chain assertion as a boundary: after that assertion passes, later queries can retain a subject that a rerender has detached. Split chains where a fresh lookup is needed and wait on an observable condition. This differs from configuring another attempt of the whole test after failure; arbitrary waits do not establish correct state.
sections.zh: 重试指南区分关联查询／断言与只执行一次的非查询命令，也将链中断言描述为边界：通过后，后续查询可能保留已被重新渲染移除的对象。需要重新定位处应拆链，并等待可观察条件。这不同于失败后重试整项测试，任意等待不证明状态正确。

sections.title_en: Browser isolation does not erase every storage mechanism
sections.title_zh: 浏览器隔离不会清除所有存储
sections.en: With E2E isolation enabled, Cypress clears the page, cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage. The documentation explicitly says other storage, notably IndexedDB, persists for the browser lifetime. Component tests always reset their documented context, while E2E can override isolation. Plan server-side fixtures and any additional storage cleanup separately. Verify a test can stand alone instead of relying on a previous test’s login or data mutation.
sections.zh: 启用端到端隔离时，Cypress 清除页面、cookie、localStorage 及 sessionStorage。文档明确其他存储，尤其 IndexedDB，在浏览器生命周期内保留。组件测试始终重置文档所述上下文，端到端则可覆写隔离设置。服务端样本及其他存储清理需另行规划，应验证单项独立运行，而非依赖前项登录或数据修改。

sections.title_en: Cross-origin flows need the documented command boundary
sections.title_zh: 跨源流程需要文档规定的命令边界
sections.en: An origin includes scheme, hostname and port. Commands on a second origin within one test need cy.origin(); current guidance no longer treats related subdomains as automatically interchangeable. The page also lists cross-origin iframes as unsupported and documents errors for HTTPS-to-HTTP navigation. Evaluate the exact login/payment flow against these boundaries before choosing test architecture. This profile does not recommend disabling browser security or altering production authentication.
sections.zh: 源由协议、主机名及端口组成。同一测试内第二源的命令需用 cy.origin()，当前指南不再将关联子域自动视作可互换，也列出不支持跨源 iframe、HTTPS 转 HTTP 会报错。选测试架构前需按这些边界评估真实登录／支付流程。本文不建议关闭浏览器安全或改生产认证。

sections.title_en: A Modified label does not identify who just changed a test
sections.title_zh: Modified 标签不能说明谁刚改过测试
sections.en: Cloud matches a test by spec path and title, then compares its body and hooks with earlier recorded versions, including the base branch. Renaming can make a test appear New; Modified can reflect a baseline difference rather than the latest edit on the current branch. Inspect the actual diff and comparison before assigning a cause. Keep failed attempts and point-of-failure artifacts when investigating an eventual pass.
sections.zh: Cloud 按 spec 路径及标题匹配测试，再将正文／hook 与此前录制版本比较，可能包括基准分支。改名可令测试显示 New，Modified 也可能来自基线差异，而非当前分支最近编辑。归因前需检查实际 diff 和比较对象；调查最终通过的测试时也应保留失败尝试及失败点产物。

sections.title_en: Recorded context still needs environment identifiers
sections.title_zh: 录制上下文仍需环境标识
sections.en: Recorded runs expose result/spec/error views and artifacts such as screenshots, videos and CI output. Their header includes browser, OS and Cypress version, but the guide notes that other details such as Node.js may require run tags. Preserve the target build and environment alongside the run. An AI error summary is an investigation aid; inspect the actual command and assertion evidence before concluding that a product regression occurred.
sections.zh: 录制运行提供结果／spec／错误视图及截图、视频、CI 输出等产物。页头含浏览器、系统及 Cypress 版本，但指南提醒 Node.js 等信息可能需运行标签。应连同运行保留目标构建及环境。AI 错误摘要只是排查辅助，认定产品回归前需检查真实命令及断言证据。

sections.title_en: Cloud results and prompt executions have separate quotas
sections.title_zh: Cloud 结果与提示执行有独立配额
sections.en: The visible Starter plan is free with ten users, five hundred recorded test results and one hundred prompt executions per month. Team displays $67/month billed $799 annually, with annual result/prompt allowances; higher plans add distinct features. The thirty-day premium trial is separate from the continuing Starter allowances. Estimate CI frequency, test count and prompt use against the selected billing period, then confirm overage and retention terms in the actual account.
sections.zh: 可见 Starter 免费，含十用户、每月五百录制测试结果及一百次提示执行。Team 显示月均 $67、年付 $799，并有年度结果／提示额度，更高层增加不同功能。三十天高级功能试用与持续 Starter 配额分开。应按所选账期估算 CI 频率、测试数及提示使用，再在真实账户核超额和保留条款。
